title: Basic
description: Start at the section, not always at Home. The last item is the current page: it has aria-current and isn't a link.

title: Home icon and overflow
description: A home icon keeps its label for screen readers. Past maxItems the middle collapses behind a button that reveals it.

title: Composed
description: Item children render the same levels as items, so a level can hold markup or a click handler. The last one is the current page.
